description: Moves a confirmed booking to `start` with the same hosts. Get valid times from get_available_slots with this `bookingId` and `token`. The calendar event is updated and its provider notifies attendees. Payment carries over. Not possible after `changeableUntil` (409 change_too_late).

id.description: the booking id from create_booking, or its manageUrl

start.description: one of the `slots` values from get_available_slots, as given (ISO in UTC)

token.description: the token from create_booking, or the manageUrl

name: reschedule_booking_as_invitee
title: Reschedule a booking (invitee)
